browser-derived-layout.rationale: Pinned Mermaid propagates DOM text measurements into an explicit root formula; the remaining exact root value is browser-dependent while descendants retain parity.

browser-root-bbox.rationale: Pinned Mermaid computes the final root from SVG getBBox; deterministic emitted-content bounds preserve semantics but not browser font, stroke, transform, or float-lattice facts.

c4-headless-layout.rationale: C4 ports the pinned screenBounds layout but replaces browser screen and text facts with explicit headless container dimensions and operation-owned deterministic measurement.

ishikawa-roughjs.rationale: The hand-drawn fixture preserves source structure while exact RoughJS path jitter and stroke bbox geometry remain implementation-specific.
